description: Add or remove labels on a Gmail message. Use this for common email actions: - Mark as read: remove_label_ids = ["UNREAD"] - Mark as unread: add_label_ids = ["UNREAD"] - Star: add_label_ids = ["STARRED"] - Unstar: remove_label_ids = ["STARRED"] - Archive: remove_label_ids = ["INBOX"] - Move to inbox: add_label_ids = ["INBOX"] - Mark important: add_label_ids = ["IMPORTANT"] - Mark as spam: add_label_ids = ["SPAM"], remove_label_ids = ["INBOX"] - Move to trash: add_label_ids = ["TRASH"], remove_label_ids = ["INBOX"] The message_id should come from gmail_search or gmail_get_message results. This Gmail connection has no untrash, spam or filter tools. Restore a message from Trash with remove_label_ids ["TRASH"] and add_label_ids ["INBOX"]; mark spam with add_label_ids ["SPAM"] and remove_label_ids ["INBOX"] (the reverse for not spam). If Gmail refuses a system label, tell the user plainly that this connection cannot do that and that they can do it in Gmail. It cannot create, read or change Gmail filters: tell the user plainly and point them to Gmail's settings instead of trying other tool names or the browser.

add_label_ids.description: Label IDs to add. Common labels: STARRED, IMPORTANT, TRASH, SPAM. Use INBOX to move back to inbox.

message_id.description: The message ID to modify labels on. Use a message_id from gmail_search or gmail_get_message.

remove_label_ids.description: Label IDs to remove. Common: UNREAD (mark as read), INBOX (archive), STARRED, IMPORTANT, SPAM.
